faq_heading: Homes near Edgewood Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Edgewood Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Edgewood Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active houses, townhomes and condos whose listing description names Edgewood Elementary. MLS® listings are not tagged by school, so a nearby home whose listing does not name the school will not show, and a listing that does can be farther than 1 km away.

Edgewood Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 16666 23 Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names Edgewood Elementary. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 1 km of the school.
How the Edgewood Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Edgewood Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Edgewood Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Edgewood Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.
Walk the route to Edgewood Elementary the way a child would, and count the crossings and sidewalks.
